title: Format Whole Project with YADF
summary: Runs YADF formatting across a project's files, with indexing involved as part of the same action
intro: Read this when you want a whole project brought to house style in one action instead of file by file. Choose drag-lint > Format Whole Project with YADF...; from the command line there is no single verb, only format per file and index.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Format Whole Project with YADF...
steps: drag-lint > Format Whole Project with YADF...
Confirm; every unit in the project is formatted and the index is refreshed

surfaces.usage: drag-lint format <file> [--yadf-path PATH] [--dry-run] [--diff] (rewrites the file IN PLACE via YADF; --dry-run resolves + version-checks and writes nothing, --diff formats a copy and prints the diff. Refuses YADF older than 1.0.6.6 (exit 4) and restores the file if formatting changes what the unit declares (exit 5))
help: drag-lint format <file> [--yadf-path PATH] [--dry-run] [--diff]   (rewrites the file IN PLACE via YADF; --dry-run resolves + version-checks and writes nothing, --diff formats a copy and prints the diff. Refuses YADF older than 1.0.6.6 (exit 4) and restores the file if formatting changes what the unit declares (exit 5))
